description: Attribute each conversion on the ad platform to a marketing channel using last-touch attribution with a 7-day lookback. The attributed touch of a conversion is the same user's most recent touch with touch_ts <= conversion_ts and touch_ts >= conversion_ts - INTERVAL 7 DAY (both bounds inclusive; ties by highest touch_id). Conversions with no eligible touch go to channel 'unattributed'. Each conversion is attributed exactly once. Output columns: channel (STRING), conversions (INT64), revenue (FLOAT64). Sort by channel.

touch_ts.description: UTC timestamp of the ad interaction

edge_cases: Conversion 1 has two eligible touches; only the most recent (social) gets credit
Conversion 2 happens more than 7 days after the last touch and is unattributed
Touch that happens after the conversion (user 2) is not eligible
Touch exactly 7 days before the conversion (user 3) is eligible (inclusive bound)
common_failure_modes: FM1: Joining conversions to all touches in the window credits conversion 1 to both search and social, duplicating revenue
FM2: Using a strict '>' for the lookback bound or calendar-date arithmetic drops the exactly-7-days touch
FM1: INNER JOIN removes unattributed conversions so channel totals no longer reconcile with total revenue
